# FeedbackHub - llms.txt

> LLM-readable manifest (https://llmstxt.org). Features-only; no fabricated traffic or unverified payment claims.

## Name & positioning
- Product name: FeedbackHub
- One-line value: FeedbackHub groups scattered user feedback from Slack, DMs, or surveys into themes with a frequency count and a suggested 'build next' pick — for solo founders drowning in notes.
- Domain: https://feedback-hub.lxsaihub.com/
- Language: English (en)

## Domain context (verified primary sources)
- NN/g — User Interviews: How, When, and Why to Conduct Them: https://www.nngroup.com/articles/user-interviews/
- Atlassian — Building a product roadmap: https://www.atlassian.com/agile/product-management/product-roadmaps

## FAQ
Q1. What is FeedbackHub?
A1. A tool that groups scattered user feedback into themes with a frequency count and suggests a 'build next' item.
Q2. Where can feedback come from?
A2. You can paste lines from Slack, DMs, or surveys.
Q3. Does it count frequency?
A3. Yes. Each theme carries a frequency count so you see what repeats.
Q4. What is the build-next pick?
A4. It is a suggested first roadmap item derived from the most frequent themes.
Q5. Do I need a spreadsheet?
A5. No. It is built to replace the manual spreadsheet synthesis.
Q6. Who should use it?
A6. Solo founders and small teams who collect feedback everywhere but never turn it into a roadmap.
